thread:
tim: heads-up — ACME procurement wants a 12mo reserved commit but with per-route guarantees: 20 rps for embeddings + monthly burst pool. sales needs a term sheet, legal needs contract language. can product/ops scope?
jess: noted. Key Q: hosted vs dedicated? dedicated changes cost model a lot. @omar can you do a quick delta for sustained 20rps embeddings + 2x burst for 30d?
omar: on it. quick back-of-envelope: 20 rps embeddings sustained -> ~600k tokens/day on our shim => ~X GPU-hours/day. rough infra delta = ~$18k/mo, ops overhead + runbook ~0.2 FTE. sharing spreadsheet: https://goo.gl/example (w/ assumptions).
liz: product idea: ship a "Route Isolation" add-on (reserved qps per route + burst credits + priority batching). MVP scope: embeddings + reranking only, console toggle, billing SKU, routing policy and API flag. estimate 8–10 weeks for end-to-end.
neil: ops concerns: capacity isolation must not starve other tenants. propose priority queue + soft reservation (we schedule reserved slots, but allow preemption if cluster idle). need fallback routing to lower-tier model variant. require runbook + canary plan to ~5 customers.
sara: legal: avoid absolute "guarantee" phrasing. suggest: "commercially reasonable efforts to provide reserved capacity" + a defined credit formula for missed commitments. also need to cap credit exposure. i'll draft clause and share.
jess: launch acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) billing SKU and pricing matrix 2) console UI to configure per-route qps 3) routing policy + automated fallback 4) runbook + SRE on-call + canary with SLA targets 5) legal sign-off on term language.
tim: sales asks for three pricing tiers to propose in term sheet: Starter (no reserve), Pro (reserved qps, no SLA), Enterprise (reserved qps + burst credits + SLA & 24/7 support). @jess can you propose numbers?
omar: initial cost model attached — Pro: $12k/mo (covers infra + 20% margin), Enterprise: $28k/mo with SLA buffer. margins look okay but depends on utilization.
liz: to reduce scope/time, MVP will limit: embeddings model only; no function-calling or generative outputs. also we'll default quantized embedding config to reduce GPU footprint.
neil: infra notes: we need two scheduler features: 1) per-tenant soft reservations, 2) burst token bucket tracked per-customer. both require ~3 sprints of infra work. plus monitoring for token burn.
jess: negotiation points with ACME: - cap monthly burst pool (e.g., 1M tokens) - rollback fallback to best-effort route if exhausted - 30d notice for commit cancellation? sales please confirm.
tim: ACME wants a monthly price cap and no cancellation for first 6 months. sales to confirm commercial flex. worth flagging to finance.
sara: also add force-majeure and data residency clauses if they insist on private deployment.
omar: spreadsheet updated with 3 price scenarios and break-evens. link: https://goo.gl/example2
jess: next steps / owners: - jess: term sheet w/ 3 tiers - liz: product spec (API flag, console, routing) - omar: final cost model & assumptions - neil: runbook + infra spec - sara: contract language draft
marta-bot: created task PROD-4321 for Roadmap: Route Isolation Add-on (assignee: liz)
tim: schedule weekly sync. propose Tuesdays 10am PT.
jess: fine for me.
liz: ack.
neil: ack.
sara: will aim for draft by Fri.
omar: numbers done by Friday.
